SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on External body parts -head, -hands -legs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: as learner manipulates digital devices to watch videos and listen to video clips on external body parts while observing safety.

Values:
• Unity: learner enhances fairness when taking turns in playing games on external body parts.

• Respect: learner enhances respect to self and others when singing songs on external body parts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Developmental perspectives: learner develops self- awareness when naming external body parts of self

Link to other learning area:

The learner is able to relate the concept of using hands when creating images using finger painting technique in Creative Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Charts, picture cards of body parts, flash cards, diagrams of external body parts, glue, crayons, balls, ropes, learners themselves, dolls, digital
